outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (congenital anomaly, macrosomia, preterm delivery, perinatal mortality, pregnancy termination)
finding: Polyhydramnios was idiopathic in almost half of the cases, while maternal diabetes and fetal conditions, especially central nervous system and gastrointestinal anomalies, accounted for the remaining cases, and adverse pregnancy outcomes occurred in the majority of pregnancies complicated by polyhydramnios.
